curriculum_compounding.reason: a generation in the window did not improve

negative_controls: a world with no shared structure
sealed and training goals split by function hash
verification across all 65,536 pairs plus a separate integer evaluator
limitations: The structured world is built to reward reuse, and the ladder was designed knowing the arithmetic family; an automatic curriculum is a stronger test, which LA-015 attempts.
Goals are 8-bit functions and solutions are mostly known constant multiplications, so this is not new mathematics.
Sealed goals derive from public seeds so a reviewer can regenerate them, unlike a private NC-061 commitment.
Search matches expressions on 64 probes, with exhaustive verification only of what it returns.
The separate evaluator matches a canonical ISA program in tests but expressions are not compiled to ISA programs.
Library capped at 48 concepts, and CPU was measured under shared load.
